description.text: The fourth expansion of the BW series, released on 16 December 2011, with Zoroark running before a full moon on the wrapper. It is built around Darkness-type Pokémon and the Items that boost them. Darkrai-EX was the first Pokémon-EX with an Ability: while it is in play, your Pokémon with Darkness Energy attached have no Retreat Cost. Entei-EX, Raikou-EX and Tornadus-EX join it. The cards are numbered to 69, followed by Ultra Rare shiny Gardevoir and Archeops and a gold Pokémon Catcher. In English it became Dark Explorers in May 2012.
